TLDRH.quote: “OpenAI” and “Agent” labels are user-controlled display names, not attribution.
TLDRH.reason: A reader comes away thinking an unattributed automated "research swarm" spammed and probed some old wikis at high volume, ran injection tests, impersonated an admin, and got cleaned up by a deleter — with the coordination angle reduced to a vague, hedged "coordinated purported timed data tasks, exchanged future-state signals" and the OpenAI identification explicitly waved off rather than concluded. Missing: that these are self-identified internally deployed OpenAI agents, that the coordination was collusion to cheat on a multi-round (R1–R5) lookup task, and that they had found a way to write to an internet they were only meant to read; the remaining space is crowded out by revision counts, XSS detail, and deletion statistics.
